source: 623 Grave Digging
target: 623 Sepulchrorum Excavatio

source: In the endless darkness, cramped quarters, and jumbled thoughts, Lumian found himself unusually frustrated, even within the confines of his dreams.
target: In tenebris infinitis, in cellis angustis, et in cogitationibus confusis, Lumian se insolite vexatum invenit, etiam intra limites somniorum sui.

source: He longed to rip apart the cage around him and shatter everything in his path.
target: Desiderabat caveam circum se dirumpere et omnia in via sua frangere.

source: Slowly, the realization dawned upon him that he was dreaming.
target: Paulatim intellexit se somniare.

source: He struggled to open his eyes and wake up, but his efforts were in vain.
target: Conatus est oculos aperire atque evigilare, sed conatus eius frustra erant.

source: Each time he thought he had finally awakened, in the blink of an eye, he plunged into a deeper darkness and a more profound dream.
target: Quoties putabat se tandem evigilavisse, in ictu oculi, in tenebras altiores et somnia profundiora immergitur.

source: After an unknown stretch of time, Lumian naturally awoke to some light seeping through the curtained window.
target: Post tempus ignotum, Lumian naturaliter evigilavit ad aliquam lucem quae per fenestram velatam intrabat.

source: It was 6 a.m.
target: Erat hora sexta matutina.

source: Lumian raised his right hand and wiped his forehead, sensing a layer of cold sweat.
target: Lumian dextram manum attollit et frontem purgavit, stratum sudoris frigidi sentiens.

source: Is this a spiritual warning, or had memories of the Samaritan Women’s Spring and the afterimage of the Blood Emperor haunted me after I contemplated the smell of death on Hanth Island yesterday?
target: Num hoc est monitum spirituale, an memoriae Fons Mulierum Samaritarum et imago remanens Imperatoris Sanguinis me vexaverunt postquam de odore mortis in Insula Hanth cogitabam?

source: Previously, I had drawn connections between the mysterious deaths of those who witnessed the Demon and the Montsouris ghost, possibly leading to a shallow corruption?
target: Prius coniunxi inter mortes mysteriosas eorum qui Daemoni et phantasma Montsouris conspecti erant, fortasse ad levem corruptionem ducens?

source: Lumian couldn’t accurately decipher the complete meaning of the dream.
target: Lumian non potuit totam significationem somnii accurate explicare.

source: All he could do was remind himself to be cautious and stay focused on his original goal for coming to Hanth Island:
target: Omne quod facere potuit, fuit se admonere ut cautus esset atque in proposito originali, quo ad Insulam Hanth venisset, maneret intentus:

source: To investigate the Demon legends, not to eliminate the Demon.
target: Ad legendas de Daemone investigandas, non ad Daemonem exstirpandum.

source: Setting aside whether he possessed the strength to face the Demon or if he needed assistance, the fact that the Church of Earth Mother had operated on the island for over a century without completely eradicating the target suggested even the Tarot Club’s Major Arcana card holders might not resolve this matter entirely.
target: Neglexisse utrum vires ad Daemonem oppugnandum haberet aut auxilium desideraret; quod Ecclesia Matris Terrae per plus quam centum annos in insula operata est sine metae omnino exstirpatione, significabat etiam possessoribus Chartarum Arcana in Tarot Club fortasse rem omnino non soluturum esse.

source: Lumian got out of bed and retrieved the golden pocket watch from Salle de Bal Brise.
target: Lumian ex lecto evexit et horologium aureum de Salle de Bal Brise cepit.

source: Opening and glancing at it: 6:01 a.m.
target: Aperiens et intuebatur, apparuit: 6:01 a.m.

source: Though early, Lumian felt a sense of urgency.
target: Quamquam mane erat, Lumian sensum urgentiae habuit.

source: The Berries would depart from Hanth Island the morning after tomorrow.
target: Berries ex Insula Hanth mane postero discedent.

source: He had only two days to delve into the Demon legends, unravel the truth, and identify potential suspects.
target: Duo tantum dies habebat ad legendas de Daemone discendas, veritatem explicandam, et suspectos detegendos.

source: If he succeeded, his Conspirer potion might very well be digested.
target: Si successisset, poculum Conspiratoris eius fortasse bene digeretur.

source: Gathering, screening, and utilizing information were crucial aspects of a conspiracy!
target: Colligere, examinare, et adhibere informationem erant aspectus fundamentales coniurationis!

source: And if Lumian were a Sequence 7 Detective of the Reader pathway, successfully solving a century-old unsolved case involving high-level powers in just two days would be a remarkable leap from initial digestion to complete digestion.
target: Et si Lumian esset Detective Sequenciae 7 in via Lectoris, casum centennalem insolutum, qui potentias altissimas implicabat, in tantum duos dies solvendo, esset saltus mirabilis ab initio digestionis ad plenam digestionem.

source: At 9 a.m., in the suburbs of Port Hanth, Return Cemetery.
target: Hora 9 a.m., in suburbis Portus Hanth, Cimiterium Return.

source: Holding a bunch of yellow flowers, Lumian navigated through the tree-lined cemetery.
target: Tenens fasciculum florum flavorum, Lumian per cimiterium arboribus ornatum iter fecit.

source: Armed with Ludwig’s intel and the insights from the previous night’s dream, he adjusted his plan.
target: Armatus notitia Ludovici et perspicientia ex somnio noctis praeteritae, consilium suum temperavit.

source: Instead of hastily venturing into the forest to search for the missing people’s remains, he decided to dig up graves here!
target: Pro festinato in silvas irrumpendo ut reliquias hominum amissorum quaereret, statuit hic sepulchra fodere!

source: His objective: to investigate the circumstances surrounding the mysterious death of someone who had glimpsed the Demon’s figure in the forest depths.
target: Propositum: indagare circumstantias mortis mysteriosae cui Daemoni figuram in silvarum profundis intueri licuit.

source: He aimed to discover if they would meet the same fate as those killed by the Montsouris ghost—exhibiting self-mutilation.
target: Studuit cognoscere num ipsi eundem fatum accederent ac illi interfecti a phantasma Montsouris, qui se ipsos mutilabant.

source: According to the gathered information, the last person to report the Demon’s presence to the Church of Earth Mother rested in a quiet corner of Return Cemetery.
target: Ex informationibus collectis, novissimus qui praesentiam Daemoni Ecclesiae Matris Terrae attigit, in angulo quieto Cimiterii Return quiescebat.

source: His name was Antonio Elias.
target: Nomen eius erat Antonio Elias.

source: Before long, Lumian, clutching the bouquet of yellow flowers, reached the grave.
target: Non multo post, Lumian, fasciculum florum flavorum tenens, ad sepulcrum pervenit.

source: Apart from the deceased’s name, birth and death dates, a concise epitaph adorned the stone tombstone: "This wretched man’s life was taken by a Demon."
target: Praeter nomen defuncti, dies natalis et obitus, epitaphium concisum lapide inscriptum erat: "Vita huius miseri viri a Daemone sublata est."

source: Lumian stooped down, placing the bouquet before the tombstone.
target: Lumian se inclinavit, fasciculum florum ante monumentum lapideum posuit.

source: Then, he straightened up, silently studying the stone tomb.
target: Tum se erexit et tacite lapidem sepulchri contemplatus est.

source: Details about Antonio Elias flashed through his mind.
target: Notitiae de Antonio Elias per mentem eius fulserunt.

source: A local, not a foreigner, with parents, a wife, and children.
target: Indigena, non peregrinus, cum parentibus, uxore, et liberis.

source: Nine months ago, during a hunting trip in the forest, he encountered a wandering Demon.
target: Ante novem menses, in venatione per silvam, Daemoni vagantis occurrit.

source: Fearing his imminent demise, he sought refuge in the cathedral and cloister of the Church of Earth Mother for a full five months.
target: Timens mortem imminentem, quaesivit asylum in cathedrali et claustro Ecclesiae Matris Terrae per quinque menses.

source: Afterwards, intending to serve as a crew member for three years, steering clear of Hanth Island and its hidden dangers, he was discovered dead at the bottom of the cabin on his second voyage…
target: Postea, cum pro membrum turmae per tres annos servire intendisset, et Insulam Hanth atque eius pericula occulta vitare conaretur, in fundo cellae secundae navigationis mortuus inventus est…

source: Lumian scanned the surroundings, gathering ten to twenty withered branches from beneath nearby trees.
target: Lumian circumspiciebat, decem ad viginti ramos ex arboribus vicinis exaridatos colligens.

source: He planted them around Antonio Elias’s tomb, forming a short, makeshift, and somewhat futile barrier.
target: Illos circum sepulcrum Antonio Elias conposuit, creando parvum, improvisum, et aliquatenus vanum obstaculum.

source: Lastly, he laid a withered branch flat on two adjacent branches, constructing a shaky door impassable to anyone.
target: Denique, unam ramum exaridatum super duas ramas adiacentis posuit, construens ianuam instabilem, quam nemo transire poterat.

source: With that completed, Lumian stepped over the "wall" and entered the grave.
target: Hoc confectum, Lumian "murum" transiit et sepulcrum intravit.

source: He then bent down, extending his right hand to touch the makeshift door constructed of withered branches.
target: Tum se inclinavit, extendens dextram manum ad ostium improvisum ex ramis exaridis tactandum.

source: Simultaneously, a black mark activated on his body.
target: Simul, in corpore eius notatio nigra excitata est.

source: In the blink of an eye, Lumian’s figure vanished.
target: In ictu oculi, figura Lumiani evanuit.

source: Antonio’s tomb remained undisturbed, except for the added circle of withered branches.
target: Sepulcrum Antonio intactum mansit, excepto circulo ramorum exaridatorum addito.

source: In reality, Lumian had retrieved an iron pick, shovel, and other items from his just-purchased Traveler’s Bag.
target: Revera, Lumian ex sacculo viatoris nuper empto dolabram ferream, palam, et alia instrumenta cepit.

source: He began prying open the stone slabs and digging into the soil.
target: Incepit lapideas laminas discindere et terram fodere.

source: Bottle of Fiction!
target: Ampulla Ficta!

source: Lumian utilized the "wall" and "door" he had fashioned to employ the Bottle of Fiction contract ability.
target: Lumian muro et ianua, quas confecerat, ad usum facultatis contractus "Ampulla Ficta" adhibuit.

source: In less than two minutes, relying on his understanding of the cemetery’s layout and two precise explosions, Lumian cleared the soil from the coffin and pried open the black-painted wooden plank.
target: Infra duo minuta, innixus intellectione dispositionis cimiterii et duabus explosionibus precisis, Lumian terram e sarcophago purgavit et tabulam ligneam nigro pictam discidit.

source: A pungent odor of decay wafted out, and Lumian casually ignited it.
target: Odor acre putredinis effluit, et Lumian id casualiter incendit.

source: After a brief wait, he squatted down, donned gloves, and examined the white bones, now devoid of flesh and blood.
target: Post breve, se genu flectit, chirothecas induit, et ossa alba, iam sine carne et sanguine, examinavit.

source: The first item he picked up was Antonio Elias’s skull.
target: Primum quod sustulit, fuit cranium Antonio Elias.

source: With a cursory glance, he noted cracks on the inside of the skull, while the exterior remained intact.
target: Cursu intuerente, fissuras in parte interiori cranii animadvertit, dum exterior pars intacta remanebat.

source: A brain explosion as the cause of death?
target: Explosio cerebri, ut causa mortis?

source: Lumian pondered the force required to induce such damage.
target: Lumian meditatus est de vi necessaria ad talem damnum inferendum.

source: Regardless of the ability responsible, Antonio’s cerebrum, cerebellum, and brain stem should have exploded into mush at the time of his demise.
target: Indifferenter ab abilitate responsali, cerebrum, cerebellum, et truncus cerebri Antonii in lutos dissolutos esse debuerunt tempore mortis eius.

source: It seemed illogical for the hard inner cranium to crack while the soft brain remained unharmed.
target: Incohense videbatur ut cranium internum durum discerperetur, dum cerebrum molle intactum maneret.

source: Examining Antonio Elias’s other bones yielded no additional injuries.
target: Examinata alia ossa Antonii Elias, nullae vulnerationes additae detectae sunt.

source: The stains in the coffin offered no further clues.
target: Maculae in sarcophago nullas alias inditia praebebant.

source: Lumian concluded that Antonio’s death resulted from an internal explosion in his head.
target: Lumian concludit mortem Antonii ex explosione interna in capite orta esse.

source: The explosive force, while not physically strong enough to shatter his skull entirely, was sufficient to destroy his brain.
target: Vis explosiva, quamvis non satis fortis ut totum cranium confringeret, sufficiens erat ad cerebrum eius destruendum.

source: With Fire Infusion, I can precisely control the quantity and quality of the flames.
target: Cum Infusione Ignis, possum quantitatem et qualitatem flammarum precise regere.

source: I should be able to achieve a similar effect.
target: Poterim effectum similem assequi.

source: How did the Demon do it?
target: Quomodo Daemon id fecit?

source: Lumian’s comprehension of the Demon pathway came from his sister’s grimoires, information provided by the Tarot Club, and Franca’s account.
target: Comprehensio viae Daemoni a grimmoriis sororis eius, ab informationibus Tarot Club datis, et narratione Francae orta est.

source: He had only truly interacted with a Demon above Sequence 6 once, and that was with Naboredisley.
target: Semel tantum vere cum Daemone super Sequenciam 6 communicavit, et id fuit cum Naboredisley.

source: He immediately recollected the sensations when Naboredisley stirred his desires and emotions.
target: Statim recoluit sensus, cum Naboredisley cupiditates et motus eius excitavit.

source: The echoes of the ranting transmitted through the gray fog during Naboredisley’s expulsion and the tumult of his own desires replayed in his mind.
target: Resonantia impetuosi sermonis per nebulam cineream, tempore expulsionis Naboredisley, et tumultus propriarum cupiditatum in mente eius iterum recitabantur.

source: For ordinary people, inducing an upheaval in their desires before detonating them could lead to their brains exploding, given an increase in potency…
target: Pro hominibus ordinariis, excitare tumultum in cupiditatibus suis antequam detonent, potest cerebra eorum explodere, si potentia augeatur…

source: It shouldn’t be a challenging feat for a demigod creature like a Demon.
target: Non debet esse opus difficile pro creatura semidei ut Daemon.

source: Moreover, the Demon can use those ravings to achieve this remotely?
target: Praeterea, Daemon his insanis sermonibus ad hoc remoto uti potest?

source: As Lumian completed his deduction, he was convinced that a Demon was indeed concealed on Hanth Island.
target: Cum Lumian deductionem finivisset, persuasus est Daemon re vera in Insula Hanth absconditum esse.

source: A Demon of the Criminal pathway, a Demon surpassing Sequences like Devil and Desire Apostle.
target: Daemon viae Criminalis, daemon qui Sequencias ut Diabolus et Desire Apostle superat.

source: With this confirmation, Lumian believed it would be relatively straightforward to locate the Demon if he put his mind to it.
target: Hoc confirmatione accepta, Lumian credidit fore ut relative facile Daemon reperiret, si animum suum ad id converteret.

source: However, the prerequisite was finding it and not resolving the situation, all while risking his life.
target: Attamen, praerequisitum erat eum reperire, non rem solvere, dum vitam suam in periculum adduceret.

source: Removing the glove, he reached into his Traveler’s Bag and touched the Flog boxing gloves.
target: Manicam removens, in sacculo viatoris pervenit et manicas pugilisticas Flog tetigit.

source: Following the incident with the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings and the Great Mother, Lumian had already speculated that the Mother Tree of Desire stood at the peak of the Prisoner, Criminal, and Scrooge pathways.
target: Post casum cum Caelesti Digno Caeli et Terrae pro Benedictionibus et Magna Mater, Lumian iam coniectaverat Arbor Matris Desiderii in vertice viarum Captivi, Criminalis, et Scrooge esse.

source: Therefore, the Rose School of Thought’s indulgence faction and some members of the Devil family believed in Her and followed Her.
target: Ita, factiones indulgentiae Scholae Rosae Cogitationis et nonnulli ex membris familiae Diaboli in Eam crediderunt et eam secuti sunt.

source: Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
target: Autores in WebNovel directe sustinete!

source: In that case, the Flog boxing gloves made from the branches of the Tree of Shadow, closely related to the Mother Tree of Desire, had a high chance of attracting the Demon’s attention within a certain range.
target: In hoc casu, manicae pugilisticae Flog ex ramis Arboris Umbrae factae, proxime coniunctae cum Arbore Matris Desiderii, magnam occasionem habebant Daemoni attentionem intra certum spatium alliciendi.

source: Just as its negative effects meant being observed by some hidden entities, influenced and attacked by dangerous creatures!
target: Sicut effectus eius negativos significabant ut ab aliquibus entitatibus occultis observaretur, atque a creaturis periculosissimis influentibus et oppugnarentur!

source: Phew, there are no useless items.
target: Pheu, nullae res inutiles sunt.

source: Only Beyonders who don’t know how to use them.
target: Solum Beyonders, qui nesciverunt quomodo ea adhibeant.

source: Lumian chuckled self-deprecatingly and withdrew his right hand from the Flog boxing gloves.
target: Lumian, se ipsi autoeclamans, subriso derisorio, dextram manum ex manicis pugilisticis Flog subtraxit.

source: He abandoned the plan to directly lure out the Demon.
target: Consilium directe Daemonem alliciendi reliquit.

source: This decision stemmed from the realization that the Demon was still active on the island, claiming lives, yet the Church of Earth Mother hadn’t eradicated it completely!
target: Haec decisio orta est ex intellectione quod Daemon adhuc in insula vigens esset, vitas auferens, sed Ecclesia Matris Terrae eum omnino exstirpare non potuerat!

source: Having encountered various challenges, Lumian possessed a reasonable understanding of an orthodox Church’s strength.
target: Variis provocationibus occurrentibus, Lumian intelligentiam rationabilem de potentia Ecclesiae orthodoxae habebat.

source: He knew that if the Church of Earth Mother genuinely committed, it could eliminate all residents suspected to be Demons and obliterate the island, similar to what the Church of Storms had done to Bansy Harbor.
target: Sciebat, enim, si Ecclesia Matris Terrae vere constiteret, omnes incolas, qui Daemones suspiciebantur, exstirpare posse atque insulam delere, similiter quod Ecclesia Tempestatum in Portu Bansi fecisset.

source: It wasn’t that the Church of Earth Mother lacked the will, but there was a reason holding them back.
target: Non quod Ecclesia Matris Terrae voluntatis caret, sed ratio erat quae eam retardaret.

source: This brought Lumian’s thoughts back to the valley burning with sulfurous flames deep in the forest.
target: Hoc reduxit cogitationes Lumiani ad vallem, sulphureis flammis in profunda silva ardentem.

source: He believed that the Demon couldn’t be slain under regular circumstances.
target: Credidit Daemonem sub condicionibus regularibus non interficiri posse.

source: It could only be sealed and constrained.
target: Posset solum sigillari et cohiberi.

source: As the Church of Earth Mother couldn’t achieve this, and Lumian doubted his ability to do so, enticing the Demon directly would be futile and perilous.
target: Cum Ecclesia Matris Terrae hoc consequi non posset, et Lumian in sua facultate dubitaret, Daemonem directe allicere fututum et periculosum fore censuit.

source: Lumian’s current strategy involved leveraging his fake level and his allure to evil gods to traverse the forest.
target: Consilium praesentis Lumiani innixum erat in suo falso gradu et in allicientia diis malis, ad silvam transire.

source: During critical moments, he planned to use the Flog boxing gloves to see if he could converge on the mysterious valley burning with sulfur flames to investigate the source of the Demon legends.
target: In temporibus criticis, consilium habebat manicas pugilisticas Flog adhibere ut videat si in vallem mysteriosam, flammis sulphureis ardentem, convenire possit, ad fontem legendarum de Daemone investigandum.

source: In the heart of the forest, surrounded by towering trees, Lumian navigated a path untouched by human presence for years.
target: In corde silvae, arboribus excelsis circumdatus, Lumian viam peragrabat, quae per annos a praesentia humana intacta manebat.

source: He moved forward at a measured pace.
target: Procedebat passu moderato.

source: From time to time, he would extract the Flog boxing gloves, relying on intuition to guide his course.
target: Interdum, manicas pugilisticas Flog extraheret, innixus instinto ut viam suam dirigeret.

source: After ten to twenty seconds, he stowed them away.
target: Post decem ad viginti secundos, eas reponit.

source: After almost an hour, the dense forest unexpectedly cleared.
target: Post fere horam, silva densa inopinanter aperta est.

source: A menacing brown bear emerged from behind a tree, advancing toward Lumian with ponderous steps.
target: Urso fuscus minax ex post arborem emersit, et gradibus ponderosis ad Lumian accedebat.

source: “Stop, foreigner!”
target: “Siste, peregrine!”

source: The bear’s mouth emitted a buzzing human voice.
target: Os ursi vocem humanam fremitumque edidit.
